CustomField.description: ****** This should automatically adjust for new years ********
CustomField.formula: IF( Flagged_Recurring_to_Duplicate__c, IF( DAY(Created_Date_Non_Native__c) <= 5, DATE( YEAR(Created_Date_Non_Native__c), MONTH(Created_Date_Non_Native__c), 5), DATE( YEAR( ADDMONTHS(Created_Date_Non_Native__c, 1) ), MONTH( ADDMONTHS(Created_Date_Non_Native__c, 1) ), 2 ) ), NULL )
CustomField.label: Trigger Recurring Compliance
